The Tractor Boys | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|16 October 1878}} | ground = [[Portman Road]] | capacity = 30,056{{cite web|url=https://www.itfc.co.uk/portmanroad/visitus |title=Visit Us |work=Ipswich Town F.C. |access-date=21 June 2024}} | owner = Gamechanger 20 Ltd | chairman = Mark Ashton | manager = [[Gary O'Neil]] | league = {{English football updater|IpswichT}} | season = {{English football updater|IpswichT2}} | position = {{English football updater|IpswichT3}} | website = {{URL|https://itfc.co.uk}} | current = 2026–27 Ipswich Town F.C. season | pattern_la1 = _ipswich2627h | pattern_b1 = _ipswich2627h | pattern_ra1 = _ipswich2627h | pattern_sh1 = _ipswich2627h | pattern_so1 = _ipswich2627hl | leftarm1 = 0333a0 | body1 = 0333a0 | rightarm1 = 0333a0 | shorts1 = | socks1 = 0333a0 | pattern_la2 = _ipswich2627a | pattern_b2 = _ipswich2627a | pattern_ra2 = _ipswich2627a | pattern_sh2 = _ipswich2627a | pattern_so2 = _toponblackl | leftarm2 = f7ebc8 | body2 = f7ebc8 | rightarm2 = f7ebc8 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = f7ebc8 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''Ipswich Town Football Club''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Ipswich]], Suffolk, England. The club competes in the {{English football updater|IpswichT}}, the top tier of [[English football league system|English football]]. Ipswich Town were founded in 1878 but did not turn professional until 1936; the club was elected to the [[English Football League|Football League]] in 1938. Ipswich won the [[List of English football champions|league title]] in [[1961–62 Football League|1961–62]], their first season in the top flight, and finished runners-up in [[1980–81 Football League|1980–81]] and [[1981–82 Football League|1981–82]]. They finished in the top six in the First Division for ten years, and won the [[FA Cup]] in [[1977–78 FA Cup|1978]] and [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]] in [[1980–81 UEFA Cup|1981]]. They have never lost at home in European competition, having defeated [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]], [[A.C. Milan|AC Milan]], [[Inter Milan]], [[S.S. Lazio|Lazio]] and [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]].{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2002/nov/01/newsstory.sport8 |work=The Guardian |location=London |title=Bent relives Ipswich glory days to give Royle perfect start |first=David |last=Alexander |date=1 November 2002 |access-date=28 April 2013 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131231160442/http://www.theguardian.com/football/2002/nov/01/newsstory.sport8 |archive-date=31 December 2013 }} Ipswich Town have played their home games at [[Portman Road]] since 1884. The club's traditional home colours are blue shirts with white shorts and blue socks. They have a long-standing rivalry with [[Norwich City F.C.|Norwich City]], against whom they contest the [[East Anglian derby]].{{cite web|title=East Anglian Derby|url=http://www.itfc.premiumtv.co.uk/page/ClubHistory/0,,10272~1027174,00.html|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080503223958/http://www.itfc.premiumtv.co.uk/page/ClubHistory/0%2C%2C10272~1027174%2C00.html|archive-date=3 May 2008|access-date=16 March 2007|work=Ipswich Town F.C.}} {{TOC limit|3}}"}}
